name: p4-hybrid-retrieval-smoke
purpose: Small deterministic corpus for regression testing P4 retrieval behavior. It is not a superiority benchmark.

corpus.text: The authoritative SCOS operational database is PostgreSQL with pgvector.
Customer credentials terminate at cloud-control-plane; only short-lived signed internal claims enter the governed service mesh.
Historical local deployment used kubuntux and Tailscale.
Production SCOS runs on the Linode host behind Nginx and cloud-control-plane.
ControlPlaneHandler authenticates governed internal service traffic.
QueryDense performs active-snapshot code vector search within one embedding space.
planRetrieval deterministically selects safe retrieval lanes and candidate budgets.

cases.query: where do user API credentials stop before internal services?
what is the current production deployment?
find the function that searches code vectors only in the active snapshot
where are retrieval lanes and candidate budgets chosen?
which auth code supports the memory rule that customer credentials stay outside the service mesh?
